name: Comedy Club
description: A 24-hour stand-up stage built from complete sets and full specials: clean, family-friendly Dry Bar Comedy specials through the day, Jim Gaffigan's food-and-fatherhood bits at lunch and teatime, silent-era slapstick from Charlie Chaplin and Buster Keaton every morning, Don't Tell Comedy's secret-show sets for happy hour, Comedy Central Stand-Up's full specials in prime time, and Just For Laughs festival sets for late night -- with the after-dark hours reserved for the uncensored grown-up material.
